{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trade Federation ceremonial cruiser''' was a vast, elegant 1,000-passenger ceremonial cruiser "rated at Class Two."<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

The luxurious [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] was designed by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], to be used for triumphal receptions on worlds signing exclusive contracts with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Sienar considered it to be, as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], his "most beautiful"—and "largest"—creation, to date.<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
